title: Microsoft Copilot: CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources in Copilot Notebooks
summary: Hold: the governance prose incorrectly says Microsoft documents only one control for Notebooks, although the cited page explicitly lists two settings that Notebooks check. The roadmap, rollout notice, licensing descriptions and preview automation otherwise support the briefing.

claims.where: Why it matters; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: The notice does not name the setting that allows Copilot to reason over CSV and TSV files.
claims.quote: The feature will be enabled automatically for tenants that already allow Copilot to reason over CSV and TSV files. No additional configuration will be required.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn does not yet describe CSV and TSV references in Copilot Notebooks.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Notebooks" "CSV" "TSV"; "Copilot Notebooks" "reason over" "CSV". Opened cpcn-admin-configuration, cpcn-requirements, cpcn-storage and release-notes; searched release-notes for TSV (absent). Results concerned other products or other Notebook features.

claims.where: controls[0].governs; Governance controls; Governance guidance; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks governs creation and integration of Pages and Notebooks.
claims.quote: Disabled: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation and integration aren't available to the users.

claims.claim: The policy is at Microsoft 365 Apps admin center > Customization > Policy Management > policy configuration > Choose the scope > Configure Settings > Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks.
claims.quote: Select Customization from the left pane. ... Select Policy Management. ... Create a new policy configuration or edit an existing one. ... Choose the scope ... In Configure Settings ... Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks

claims.claim: POST /beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors can apply the policy baseline once using applyOnce mode.
claims.quote: POST https://graph.microsoft.com/beta/admin/configurationManagement/configurationMonitors ... An active applyOnce monitor runs in the background on behalf of the signed-in administrator and then becomes inactive.

claims.claim: The creation policy defaults to Enabled.
claims.quote: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks creation | Cloud Policy: Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks | Enabled

claims.where: controls[0].note; Governance controls; Risk assessment: Change & support
claims.claim: The documented Notebooks Cloud Policy settings are not CSV- or TSV-specific controls.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Notebooks" "reason over" "CSV"; "Copilot Notebooks" "CSV" policy configuration pricing license meter. Opened cpcn-admin-configuration and utcm-copilot-resources: creation/integration and code-preview settings, no CSV/TSV-specific setting.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance controls
claims.claim: Disabling Notebooks creation does not delete existing Pages or Notebooks.
claims.quote: Existing Copilot Pages and Notebooks aren't deleted.

claims.claim: Files added to Notebooks remain available in their original OneDrive and SharePoint storage locations when creation is disabled.
claims.quote: Original storage locations: Files added to Notebooks remain available in OneDrive and SharePoint where they're stored

claims.where: Risk assessment: Change & support; Governance controls
claims.claim: Disabling creation hides the Notebooks module in the Microsoft Copilot app for affected users.
claims.quote: the Notebooks module is hidden, preventing users from accessing existing Notebooks through the Copilot App.

claims.claim: Sharing links to Copilot Notebooks do not work when creation is disabled.
claims.quote: Sharing links to Copilot Notebooks don't work when creation is disabled via the policy in this article.

claims.claim: A policy change takes up to 90 minutes where policy configurations already existed.
claims.quote: If there were existing policy configurations before the change, the change takes up to 90 minutes to be reflected.

claims.claim: A policy change takes up to 24 hours where no policy configurations previously existed.
claims.quote: If there were no policy configurations before the change, the change takes up to 24 hours to be reflected.

claims.where: controls[0].scope; Governance controls; Governance guidance: Before rollout
claims.claim: Cloud Policy can scope the creation setting to all tenant users or a group.
claims.quote: From the Choose the scope dropdown list, choose either All users or select the group for which you want to apply the policy.

claims.claim: The one control Learn documents for Notebooks is Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks.
claims.quote: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks check the following Cloud Policy settings: Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks; Enable code previews for AI-generated content in Microsoft Copilot Chat and Copilot Pages
claims.fix: Replace the first sentence with 'Learn documents the Cloud Policy setting Create and view Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks as the creation control.' The cited page also lists a code-preview setting; do not claim this is the only documented control.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; Scope; rationale: cost
claims.claim: The requirements page says Copilot Notebooks users need the Microsoft Copilot or Copilot Chat licence.
claims.quote: Copilot Notebooks ... Users need the Microsoft Copilot or Copilot Chat license.

claims.claim: The preview TCM resource reference instead says Copilot Notebooks also require a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence.
claims.quote: Copilot Notebooks also require a Microsoft 365 Copilot license.

claims.claim: CSV and TSV references are an included option within licensed Copilot Notebooks rather than a separately documented entitlement.
claims.quote: Copilot Notebooks ... Users need the Microsoft Copilot or Copilot Chat license.

claims.claim: The requirements page lists a OneDrive licence as a prerequisite for Copilot Pages.
claims.quote: Copilot Pages ... Users need a OneDrive license and an active OneDrive site.

claims.claim: Full functionality including @mentions requires an Exchange Online mailbox.
claims.quote: For full functionality including @mentions, users need an Exchange Online mailbox.

claims.where: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No separate licence specific to CSV and TSV references is published at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Notebooks" "CSV" "separate" license price meter. Opened cpcn-requirements, utcm-copilot-resources and microsoft-365-copilot-licensing (redirected to License options); read MC1519841. Only product-level licence requirements, no file-type entitlement.

claims.claim: No price specific to CSV and TSV references is published at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Notebooks" "CSV" "separate" license price meter. Opened cpcn-requirements, utcm-copilot-resources and License options; read MC1519841 and the returned pay-as-you-go-meters excerpt. No price for CSV/TSV Notebook references.

claims.claim: No meter specific to CSV and TSV references is published at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Notebooks" "CSV" "separate" license price meter. Opened cpcn-requirements and License options; read MC1519841 and the pay-as-you-go-meters search excerpt (Chat agents and SharePoint agents). No CSV/TSV Notebook-reference meter.

claims.claim: Legacy Copilot Notebooks are those created before November 2025.
claims.quote: Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks created before November 2025 continue to be stored in the user-owned SharePoint Embedded container.

claims.claim: Legacy Copilot Notebooks count against the organisation's SharePoint storage quota.
claims.quote: All legacy Copilot Pages and legacy Copilot Notebooks count against your organization's SharePoint storage quota.

claims.claim: The storage page does not say how CSV or TSV references affect storage.
claims.quote: Searched: "Copilot Notebooks" "CSV" "TSV"; "Copilot Notebooks" "CSV" policy configuration pricing license meter. Read cpcn-storage in full: Notebook storage locations and quotas, no CSV/TSV reference-storage mechanism.

claims.claim: The supplied roadmap and notice do not state whether other clouds will follow.
claims.quote: "clouds": ["Worldwide (Standard Multi-Tenant)"]

claims.claim: The source descriptions do not describe a change to sign-in, roles or connectors for the new file types.
claims.quote: We are introducing support for using CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources in Microsoft Copilot Notebooks.

claims.claim: The notice describes user-added files used to generate responses and content, not autonomous behaviour.
claims.quote: Users will be able to add CSV and TSV files as knowledge sources in Copilot Notebooks. ... Copilot will use data contained in these files alongside other referenced content when generating responses and content.

claims.claim: TCM automation for Copilot resources is documented as preview in Microsoft Graph beta.
claims.quote: This article lists the Copilot resource types supported in preview for monitoring and snapshots through the Tenant Configuration Management (TCM) APIs in Microsoft Graph beta. These resources also support remediation and applyOnce.

claims.claim: The request's mode property accepts applyOnce to apply a baseline once.
claims.quote: mode | monitorMode | The monitor mode. The possible values are: monitorOnly, applyOnce, unknownFutureValue.

claims.claim: The policy baseline resourceType is microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks.
claims.quote: "resourceType": "microsoft.copilot.copilotpagesnotebooks"

claims.claim: The policy baseline uses resourceVersion 1.
claims.quote: All resources on this page use resourceVersion: 1 and are singletons.

claims.claim: The baseline properties.value setting uses 0 to disable and 1 to enable the policy.
claims.quote: value | Write | String | Allows or prevents creating and viewing Copilot Pages and Copilot Notebooks ... 0 disables the setting; 1 enables the setting. ... "properties": { "value": "1" }

claims.claim: TCM supports these Copilot settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.
claims.quote: TCM supports these settings only in tenant-level policies in the Microsoft 365 Apps admin center.

claims.claim: The calling app needs delegated ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All for applyOnce.
claims.quote: Creating an applyOnce monitor supports delegated permissions only. In addition to the calling app's delegated ConfigurationMonitoring.ReadWrite.All permission, the TCM service principal needs delegated permissions for the target workloads

claims.claim: Copilot applyOnce requires delegated CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite on the TCM service principal.
claims.quote: For remediation and applyOnce, grant it the CopilotPolicySettings.ReadWrite delegated permission.

claims.claim: Microsoft Graph beta APIs are not supported for production applications.
claims.quote: APIs under the /beta version in Microsoft Graph are subject to change. Use of these APIs in production applications is not supported.

claims.claim: The target setting must not be configured in any group-level policy when using TCM.
claims.quote: Before using TCM, ensure that the target setting isn't configured in any group-level policy in that admin center. If it is, monitoring, snapshots, remediation, and applyOnce fail for that resource.

claims.claim: AI Administrator is the least-privileged signed-in user role for Copilot applyOnce.
claims.quote: AI Administrator is the least-privileged role for the signed-in user for remediation and applyOnce; don't assign that user-role requirement to the service principal.
